content: {"episode_id":"ep-05012","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
